## 主要学术背景 | Scholarly background

**中文。** 丹尼索瓦人长期是一个“遗传学上清楚、考古学上模糊”的古人群：2010年以来我们知道其基因组、与现代人群的基因交流，以及西伯利亚、青藏高原、台湾海峡和东北中国的若干化石线索，但关于技术、生计、身体形态和生态适应的直接证据非常有限。蝙蝠洞把化石鉴定、古蛋白、ZooMS、牙体内部形态、石器、动物考古和环境证据放进同一遗址框架；徐家窑研究又把这一框架扩展到华北中更新世人群。

**English.** Denisovans have long been a paradoxical population: genetically well known but archaeologically elusive. Since 2010, genomes and introgression signals have been joined by fossils from Siberia, the Tibetan Plateau, the Taiwan Strait, and northeastern China, yet direct evidence for technology, subsistence, anatomy, and ecology remained sparse. Bianfu Cave integrates proteomics, ZooMS, dental internal morphology, lithics, fauna, and environmental evidence within one site, while the Xujiayao study extends the morphological discussion into northern China.

## 主要发现 | Major findings

**中文。** 2026年9月《Nature》同期两篇研究把蝙蝠洞丹尼索瓦人的化石身份与石器、动物利用和遗址环境联系起来；10月另一篇《Nature》古蛋白研究又将徐家窑一批人类遗存归入丹尼索瓦人相关支系。三篇论文共同构成2026年东亚丹尼索瓦人化石、形态与行为研究的重要进展。

**English.** Two Nature papers published together in September linked Denisovan fossils at Bianfu Cave with stone technology, faunal exploitation, and ecology; a further October Nature palaeoproteomic study on Xujiayao expanded the anatomical and geographic picture. Together they form a major 2026 research cluster on Denisovan fossils, morphology, and behaviour in eastern Asia.

## 学术重要性 | Intellectual significance

**中文。** 丹尼索瓦研究长期呈现“遗传学证据丰富、考古材料稀少”的不平衡。蝙蝠洞使研究从“丹尼索瓦人是谁”推进到“丹尼索瓦人怎样生活”，从系统发育和基因交流问题扩展到技术行为、生计与环境适应。

**English.** Denisovan research has long been asymmetrical: rich genetic evidence but sparse archaeology. Bat Cave shifts the agenda from identifying who Denisovans were toward reconstructing how they lived, bringing technology, subsistence, and ecological adaptation into a field once dominated by phylogeny and admixture.

## 学术出版物 | Academic publications

### 论文 1 | Paper 1

Rao, H., Xing, S., Ruan, Q., Bai, F., Zhao, Y., Wu, Z., Tang, S., Andrew Bennett, E., Feng, X., Lin, S., Shao, Q., Yang, X., Li, Z., Zhou, K., Liu, F., & Fu, Q. (2026). Ancient proteins identify various Denisovan remains from Southwest China. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10976-9

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 文章可在线访问；再利用许可与图像权利按出版方rights statement和单幅图署名核查。 / The article is accessible online; reuse and figure rights follow the publisher rights statement and individual credits.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 文章通过形态预筛、ZooMS 与古蛋白分析，从蝙蝠洞大量碎骨中确认多件丹尼索瓦人遗存，并扩展其已知身体部位与牙齿变异范围。它把古蛋白组学从“鉴别人群”推进到建立更丰富的丹尼索瓦化石样本。

**What the publication shows (English).** Using morphological prescreening, ZooMS and palaeoproteomics, the study identifies multiple Denisovan remains among highly fragmented bones from Bianfu Cave and expands the known anatomical and dental variation of the group. It demonstrates how palaeoproteomics can move beyond identification to building a richer Denisovan fossil record.

### 论文 2 | Paper 2

Ruan, Q., Li, H., Xing, S., Zhao, K., Liu, J., Zanolli, C., Doyon, L., Delpiano, D., Peresani, M., d'Errico, F., Demeter, F., Hublin, J.-J., Xiao, P., Wang, Y., Jia, Z., Yang, Q., Fu, Q., Sun, Q., Zhao, Y., et al. (2026). Denisovans from southwestern China and their subsistence strategies. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-10997-4

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 文章可在线访问；再利用许可与图像权利按出版方rights statement和单幅图署名核查。 / The article is accessible online; reuse and figure rights follow the publisher rights statement and individual credits.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 文章把约16.7万—13.4万年前的人类化石与约19万—7万年前的文化序列、石器、动物骨骼和环境记录结合起来，重建丹尼索瓦人的狩猎、骨骼利用与石器策略。其意义在于首次以完整遗址体系讨论丹尼索瓦人的行为与生态适应。

**What the publication shows (English).** The paper integrates hominin fossils dated to roughly 167–134 ka with a cultural sequence spanning about 190–70 ka, lithics, fauna and environmental records. It provides the first site-scale reconstruction of Denisovan hunting, bone use, technological strategy and ecological adaptation.

### 论文 3 | Paper 3

Xing, S., Wu, Z., Shao, Q., Ge, J., Bennett, E. A., Rao, H., Lin, S., Zhao, Y., Liu, F., Liu, Y., Zhou, K., Feng, X., Jiangzuo, Q., & Fu, Q. (2026). The proteome of Middle Pleistocene Xujiayao and common Denisovan morphology. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11132-z

**开放获取状态 | Open-access status.** 文章可在线访问；再利用许可与图像权利按出版方rights statement和单幅图署名核查。 / The article is accessible online; reuse and figure rights follow the publisher rights statement and individual credits.

**出版物内容（中文）。** 文章对徐家窑中更新世人类遗存进行古蛋白分析，并把所得蛋白组与东亚其他中更新世化石比较，以讨论丹尼索瓦人共有的形态特征。它扩大了丹尼索瓦人在华北的化石证据，并为重新审视东亚若干争议人类化石提供分子依据。

**What the publication shows (English).** The study applies palaeoproteomics to Middle Pleistocene human remains from Xujiayao and compares them with other East Asian fossils to investigate shared Denisovan morphology. It broadens the Denisovan fossil record in northern China and supplies molecular evidence for reassessing several taxonomically debated East Asian hominins.
